risks: Worker startup, CUDA context initialization, MPS scheduling, CPU contention, GPU contention and output I/O can reduce realized throughput below the supplied bound; higher concurrency can hurt performance despite passing resource guards.

Langevin outputs remain stochastic with fixed seeds. Scheduling or floating-point execution differences can alter trajectories; shared RNG state, seed misassignment or result mispairing would invalidate comparison.

The sealed margins are baseline cross-seed standard deviations divided by sqrt(8), not same-seed run-to-run variability or published scientific tolerances. Passing these two energy metrics does not establish equivalence of every scientific observable.

The stated joint equivalence power of at least 0.99898 is conditional on an unverified zero-median normal paired-error model with standard deviation at most one quarter of each margin. Empirical power is unavailable; without that assumption power is unknown.
